verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an official CLI. It installs globally with `npm i -g foreloop`, and `foreloop init` sets up the task-executor skill in a checkout. It covers projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal, coding agents or cron. `--json` works on every command with a stable, additive-only shape, which makes it well suited to AI-native scripting. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, a full command reference beyond init and --json, and explicit documentation of how the CLI authenticates.
